narrative:
Madison County has 27,397 registered voters, with 53.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 11.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 23.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.8% of registrants.
